dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament preliminary round results are in. Thirty-two magnificent contenders have made it through and will be showcasing a visual feast of fierce competition to you all..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Competition Rewards - Top 8: Sizable amount of Mora, limited-edition Nilotpala Cup Season 1 Honorary Title, and the permission to keep the ace Fungus..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Fungi Activity Rules - Rule #3: Fungi that are registered and controlled by a Wisdom Orb are allowed to move around freely in areas proximate to the arena. Beast tamers, please pay extra attention to the activity borders."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Activity areas only include areas around the arena and the main roads of Port Ormos. Please do not bring your Fungi to the following public areas: Wikala Funduq, shops, and restaurants."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Currently, this competition is unknown to some members of the population. Panic or chaos may occur if Fungi were to appear in front of individuals who are unaware of the competition. It is recommended that everyone manage their Fungi accordingly."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The Corps of Thirty will referee the competitors to ensure that all rules are followed. Competitors who violate the rules will be disqualified immediately. If the violation is considered a gross offense, further responsibilities may be pursued and punishment from the Akademiya may occur."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like the rules are pretty clear.

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Floating Fungi are the cutest! Whether they're Hydro, Anemo, or Dendro!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Every Floating Fungus has a big head and its body is soft. It moves around slowly, and sways back and forth as it does so."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Let's make a Floating Fungi Protection Association together!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Reminder from the staff: Competition Fungi are special, wild Fungi are dangerous!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Enjoy the competition responsibly. Please do not attempt to imitate anything you see!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Your family would be sad if you were injured by a monster!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Maybe the organizers should add some kind of balancing mechanism to make the competition more competitive."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "For example, attach a point system to each Fungus that enters battle. Each team has a limited number of points, and the stronger the Fungi, the higher the points."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "With that put in place, the competitors will need to take a strategic approach to what Fungi they include in their team. This also guarantees a more competitive atmosphere."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: You idiot! The audience won't be able to understand what's going on if the competition becomes too complicated!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: Everyone's just here to have a good time. Nobody wants to count dumb points and guess strategies while watching the competition!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: Besides, the skills of the stronger Fungi are awesome. If you restrict them from entering the arena, the competition might get stale really quickly!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The preliminary round is over. When will the competition film be available for purchase?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I'm having a hard time staying in my seat. There are so many competitors with really cool nicknames that sound like they have a strong team! Ordinary audiences won't be able to watch every single match. We need the film!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "It's okay even if it's a little pricey. After all, competitions like this are rare, and it's exciting to watch even the second or third time around!"
